original.statement: The deprecated flag `install-egress-gateway-routes` has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0.

decision.reason: [ev-91fac6720d6f] is listed under "1.16 Upgrade Notes › Removed Options" and says the deprecated flag `install-egress-gateway-routes` has been removed. That supports a cli-flag subject named --install-egress-gateway-routes (the family convention adds the leading --) with change type removed. The text does not name a specific component, so leaving component unset is correct.
